units.source_text: 接着，令人惊讶的事情发生了，
此时，原本隐没在云雾里的谷底刮起一阵风，

en.t: At that moment, a gust of wind rose from the valley floor that had been hidden in cloud and mist,

units.source_text: 风中飘来温柔的声音：“感谢发长彦君的救命之恩，

en.t: A gentle voice drifted on the wind: “I thank Lord Hatsunagahiko for saving my life,

units.source_text: 您的恩德我将永远铭记于心。

en.t: I will remember your kindness in my heart forever.

units.source_text: 我是被食蜃人百般凌辱的生驹山的驹公主。”

en.t: I am Princess Koma of Mount Ikoma, who was cruelly humiliated by the Shokushin people.”
